oneLiner: 以太阳为中心，八大行星及卫星、小行星、彗星等组成的天体系统。
oneLinerEn: The Sun-centered system of eight planets, moons, asteroids and comets.
detail: 日心说由哥白尼确立，开普勒与牛顿完善了运动规律。
detailEn: Copernicus set the heliocentric model; Kepler and Newton refined the laws.

oneLiner: 恒星靠核聚变发光；太阳位于银河系一条旋臂上。
oneLinerEn: Stars shine by fusion; the Sun lies in a spiral arm of the Milky Way.
detail: 星系由海量恒星、气体与暗物质构成，宇宙中有数千亿个星系。
detailEn: Galaxies of stars, gas and dark matter number in the hundreds of billions.

oneLiner: 星系光谱普遍红移，说明宇宙在膨胀（哈勃定律 v=H₀d）。
oneLinerEn: Cosmic redshift shows expansion (Hubble's law v=H₀d).
detail: 其中 v 为星系退行速度，H₀ 为哈勃常数，d 为星系距离。
detailEn: v recession speed, H₀ Hubble constant, d distance.

oneLiner: 宇宙源于约 138 亿年前的一次极高温高密度状态膨胀。
oneLinerEn: The universe expanded from a hot, dense state ~13.8 billion years ago.
detail: 宇宙微波背景辐射是其重要观测证据。
detailEn: The cosmic microwave background is key evidence.

oneLiner: 引力极强、连光也无法逃逸的天体，边界称为事件视界。
oneLinerEn: An object so dense that not even light escapes; bounded by the event horizon.
detail: 由大质量恒星坍缩形成；2019 年首张黑洞照片由事件视界望远镜拍摄。
detailEn: Formed by collapse of massive stars; first image captured in 2019.

oneLiner: 加速运动的质量扰动时空产生的涟漪，以光速传播。
oneLinerEn: Ripples in spacetime from accelerating masses, traveling at light speed.
detail: 2015 年 LIGO 首次直接探测到双黑洞并合产生的引力波。
detailEn: LIGO first detected them in 2015 from merging black holes.

oneLiner: 恒星由星云引力坍缩点燃，历经主序、膨胀，最终坍缩或爆发，结局由初始质量决定。
oneLinerEn: Stars ignite by gravitational collapse, live on the main sequence, then end as white dwarf, neutron star or black hole by mass.
detail: 氢聚变为氦释放辐射压以对抗引力；燃料耗尽后，小质量恒星抛出行星状星云留下白矮星，大质量者经超新星爆发留下中子星或黑洞，重元素也由此播撒宇宙。
detailEn: Hydrogen fusion balances gravity; when fuel runs out, low-mass stars shed shells as white dwarfs, massive ones explode as supernovae leaving neutron stars or black holes and seeding the cosmos with heavy elements.

oneLiner: 大爆炸约三十八万年后遗留的宇宙「余晖」，充满全天，温度仅约三开尔文。
oneLinerEn: The afterglow of the Big Bang released some 380,000 years in, filling all sky at barely about three kelvin.
detail: 炽热早期宇宙冷却到电子与质子结合成原子、光得以自由穿行，那束古老辐射今天被宇宙膨胀红移为微波；其微小的温度涨落正是星系诞生的种子。
detailEn: As the hot early universe cooled enough for atoms to form, light streamed free; that ancient glow is now redshifted to microwaves, and its tiny temperature ripples are the seeds of galaxies.

oneLiner: 不发光、只靠引力显现的神秘物质，约占宇宙物质总量的八成。
oneLinerEn: Invisible matter felt only through gravity, making up roughly four-fifths of the universe's matter.
detail: 星系外缘的旋转速度、引力透镜弯折的光与宇宙大尺度结构，都要求存在远超可见星的额外质量；其候选粒子至今尚未被直接探测到。
detailEn: Galaxy rotation curves, the light bent by gravitational lensing and cosmic structure all demand far more mass than stars supply; candidate particles remain undetected.

oneLiner: 光年指的是光在一年里走过的距离，约十万亿公里；浩瀚宇宙用光年与秒差距来丈量。
oneLinerEn: A light-year is the distance light crosses in a year, some ten trillion km; the vast cosmos is measured in light-years and parsecs.
detail: 离太阳最近的恒星约四光年之遥。天文学家用三角视差、标准烛光等「宇宙量天尺」，逐级丈量由近及远的天体距离，看远方即是在回溯过去。
detailEn: The nearest star lies just over four light-years off; astronomers ladder up distance by parallax and standard candles, and in looking far away they look back in time.
